author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#edu407 This is a good lesson analyzing characters. Focus your lesson plan on this. You do not need to include every objective and every standard your lesson will touch. Just those that you plan to measure.

I would also read the book a second time to really focus in on the characters after you introduced them on the first read.
